title: securigera elegans
intro: Securigera elegans, commonly known as annual goat's rue, is a perennial plant belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the reduction of blood sugar levels and the improvement of cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Securigera elegans include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its potential to exert a hypoglycemic effect. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
